name: SITKA Ecosystem Grants
summary: Grants from an outdoor-gear company for habitat restoration, biodiversity and collaborative conservation projects in the US and Canada; applicants first send a short inquiry and are invited to submit a full proposal.

eligibility.rule: Applicant is a US or Canadian citizen
Having prior experience in research, conservation or exploration relevant to the proposed project
Funds not for conferences, tuition, vacations, study abroad, volunteering, legal action, land, endowments or publishing

calls.label: Rolling applications

status.quote: SITKA Ecosystem Grants are accepted and reviewed on an ongoing basis

calls.note: A short inquiry comes first; full proposals follow on invitation

applicant_types.quote: Non-Profits, both local and national University researchers and research groups State and Federal Government Individuals (not affiliated with a University, non-profit or formal organization)

geography.quote: At this time, funding is restricted to United States and Canadian citizens and projects.

access.quote: To inquire about support for your work, please submit a short summary (200 words maximum) of your funding request.

window.quote: SITKA Ecosystem Grants are accepted and reviewed on an ongoing basis

effort.quote: To inquire about support for your work, please submit a short summary (200 words maximum) of your funding request.
You will be notified upon review of your inquiry how to submit a full proposal.

eligibility.quote: At this time, funding is restricted to United States and Canadian citizens and projects.
Applicant must be 18 years or older.
Must have a record of prior experience in the fields of research, conservation or exploration, which should be submitted as it pertains to the proposed project.

Funds may not be used for travel to scientific / professional meetings or conferences, tuition, vacations, study abroad programs, volunteer activities, legal actions, land acquisition, endowments, or publication of research results.
